title: Egypt: Miu and Jamal, redrawn
kaylee: Miu the kitten and Jamal the camel are redrawn in the new Nile look: bold line, round shapes, big simple eyes. They move and talk exactly as before.
questions: Miu's whiskers: keep them, or drop them like the hippo's clean face?
